tasks.name: Product catalog read API (REST)
tasks.description: Build REST endpoints for agent to query products by ID, SKU, category, and attribute filters. Return structured JSON with full attribute schema. Support pagination and bulk fetch.

tasks.name: Product catalog write API (REST)
tasks.description: Build REST endpoints for agent to create, update, and patch product records. Support partial updates (PATCH). Validate schema on write. Emit change events to downstream systems.

tasks.name: Direct DB read access layer
tasks.description: Create read-only DB views and stored procedures for agent bulk queries — category stats, data completeness scores, missing attribute reports. Use read replica to avoid impacting production writes.

tasks.name: Tool: classify_product
tasks.description: Agent tool that takes product attributes + description as input and returns the correct category path (GS1 / eCl@ss / custom). Calls classification model internally. Returns confidence score and top-3 candidates.

tasks.name: Tool: tag_product
tasks.description: Agent tool that analyses product image URL + description and returns suggested attribute tags. Maps to attribute schema. Returns tags with confidence scores. Supports batch mode for multiple SKUs.

tasks.name: Tool: sequence_images
tasks.description: Agent tool that takes a product ID and list of image URLs, identifies image types (hero/lifestyle/detail), and returns the correctly ordered sequence based on category ruleset. Applies marketplace-specific rules.

tasks.name: Tool: check_data_quality
tasks.description: Agent tool that scans a product record or category and returns a data completeness score, list of missing required fields, and recommended actions. Used to drive autonomous enrichment workflows.

tasks.name: Tool: bulk_update_products
tasks.description: Agent tool for applying updates to multiple products simultaneously (e.g. re-classify entire category, retag a brand's products). Requires HITL approval above a configurable threshold. Returns job ID for async tracking.

tasks.name: System prompt & persona design
tasks.description: Design the catalog agent's system prompt: role definition, task scope, tone, escalation rules, and constraints (e.g. never delete records without approval). Include few-shot examples for classification and tagging decisions.

tasks.name: Autonomous data quality patrol workflow
tasks.description: Build scheduled agent workflow that scans the catalog for data gaps, triggers enrichment or tagging tools, and surfaces a daily summary report. Agent runs autonomously but logs all actions for review.

tasks.name: New product onboarding workflow
tasks.description: Agent workflow triggered on new product ingestion. Sequentially runs: classify → tag → generate description → sequence images → check quality. Outputs a ready-to-publish product record or flags for human review.

tasks.name: Conflict detection & resolution logic
tasks.description: Handle cases where agent-suggested classification or tags conflict with existing human-assigned values. Define resolution policy: agent defers, flags for review, or overwrites based on confidence threshold.

tasks.name: Catalog agent dashboard
tasks.description: Build UI showing agent activity: tasks completed, products processed, quality scores improved, pending approvals, and error log. Catalog managers can review and override any agent action from this view.

tasks.name: Agent conversational interface
tasks.description: Chat UI allowing catalog managers to instruct the agent in natural language: 'Re-classify all products in the Outdoor category', 'Show me products with missing descriptions.' Agent interprets, plans, and executes.

tasks.name: Change history & rollback
tasks.description: Every agent write action creates a versioned record. UI allows catalog managers to view before/after for any field and roll back agent changes at product or batch level.

tasks.name: Agent performance metrics & reporting
tasks.description: Track agent KPIs: classification accuracy rate, tagging precision, data quality score delta, average time to onboard a product. Export reports for management review.
